name: Chess
hook: Real chess on a 3D board. Illegal moves are refused.
how: Standard chess with every rule: check, mate, castling, en passant, promotion and the draw rules. The first two players take the seats; anyone else watches. Alone? A bot plays the other side.
controls: Click or tap a piece, then one of its dots
uses: The host's browser checks every move; if it leaves, the next player takes over.
A bot takes any empty seat, so you can play alone, and a friend who joins takes the bot's side.
Players and watchers see the same board; the game carries on if someone reloads while another player stays.
Most wins, shown after every game.
